entries.text:
MR. HALE:  Variation A -- Connie cross-line.

RSIGuard is an ergonomic software application

designed to prevent and manage repetitive stress

injuries purported to track mouse clicks and key

strokes.

It doesn't track all time spent on a computer.

Q.    Variation B -- same-line over margin.

Injuries purported to track mouse clicks and widgetry.

A.    Yes.  That is correct.

Q.    Variation C -- wrap must not hit the A.

Did the software purport to track mouse clicks and gadgetry?

A.    No.  Not all computer time.

That is all for this wrap variations seed.

annotations.explanation: VARIATION A (Connie): Accept. Line 6 should become "keystrokes." — not a lone period. Unique phrase — will not collide with B/C.

annotations.suggestion: bubbly tubbly wubbly widgetry extra words
annotations.explanation: VARIATION B: Accept. Should wrap under line 10 (continuation indent), not stack past the margin, and not glue onto A on line 11.

annotations.suggestion: bubbly tubbly wubbly gadgetry and more words
annotations.explanation: VARIATION C (Q→A): Accept on the Q. Overflow stays under the Q; line 15 must remain "A. No."
